name: symplr CVO

As an NCQA-certified CVO, symplr offers fully outsourced credentialing services for health systems, hospitals, and managed care organizations.

faqs.question: What makes symplr CVO different from credentialing software?
faqs.answer: symplr CVO is a full-service Credentials Verification Organization that performs credentialing work on your behalf, while credentialing software is a tool you use to manage the process yourself. symplr CVO handles primary source verification, document collection, and ongoing monitoring as an outsourced service.

faqs.question: Is symplr CVO NCQA certified?
faqs.answer: Yes, symplr CVO maintains NCQA certification for credentials verification organization services. This certification meets the requirements for delegated credentialing from health plans and ensures compliance with industry standards for primary source verification.

faqs.question: How does symplr CVO handle privileging for behavioral health providers?
faqs.answer: symplr CVO supports privileging for all provider types including psychiatrists, psychologists, and behavioral health specialists. They work with your medical staff office to apply appropriate privilege criteria, track FPPE/OPPE requirements, and prepare credentials packets for committee review.

faqs.question: What is the typical turnaround time for symplr CVO verifications?
faqs.answer: Standard primary source verifications are typically completed within 5-10 business days. Complex cases requiring additional outreach may take longer. symplr offers expedited verification services for urgent credentialing needs with faster turnaround for additional fees.
